c1.note: 10-K states approx. 65,900 employees at Dec 31, 2025; latest annual figure as of today.

c2.note: 10-K gives 69,700 for Dec 31, 2024; prior-year comparison context.

c3.note: 10-K says approx. 8,900 of employees are in the US.

c4.note: 10-K: decrease primarily due to 2025 divestiture activity.

c5.note: The count is for the Company and its subsidiaries; independent bottlers are separate companies (10-K lists CCEP, CCHBC, etc. as bottling partners).

c8.note: AJC (Dec 31, 2025) reports the plan to reorganize throughout 2026, with some jobs eliminated and others added, per a spokesperson.

c9.note: WARN notice: 75 Atlanta HQ layoffs on Feb. 28; the date is now past.

c11.note: Stockanalysis lists 79,100 for Dec 31, 2023, consistent with the 10-K history I know.

c12.note: Headcount is reported annually in the 10-K, normally filed in February; the next is expected around February 2027. This is a forecast, not a passage-backed fact.

c13.note: 10-K attributes the 2025 drop to divestitures; the 2024 drop is consistent with refranchising (e.g. the bottling operations in Vietnam and Ghana). 'Largely' is a reasonable but partly inferred characterization.

c14.note: The 10-K confirms 65,900 is the Dec 31, 2025 figure; the claim about other sites' labeling is unverified but harmless.
